name: StoryCloze
description: StoryCloze test (also known as the ROC Stories Cloze Test) evaluates commonsense story understanding. Given a four-sentence story context, models must select the correct ending from two options. The test requires understanding narrative coherence, causal structure, and commonsense knowledge about everyday situations.
reputation: Classic narrative commonsense benchmark; used in multiple shared tasks (2016, 2018); predecessor to SWAG and HellaSwag; human performance ~100%
notes: Introduced at NAACL 2016. Training corpus (ROCStories) contains ~100K five-sentence commonsense stories. Test set (3,742 examples) requires selecting the correct story ending. Led to 2016 and 2018 shared tasks on commonsense story understanding. Now largely saturated. The SWAG benchmark used adversarial filtering to create harder commonsense problems.
